Definition: A code-neutral engineering workbench organized as five separable layers.
The layer that owns mechanics and invariant enforcement.
A layer that may import/export data but may not bypass unit, provenance, or data-boundary checks.
A reproducibility and design-iteration record; changes to a state payload create a new model state.

Synonyms: JCS-compatible JSON payload hash basis;canonical JSON/JCS-compatible payload
Definition: Accepted canonical JSON basis used for payload hashing.
Architecture decision selecting a local SQLite-backed project store/index behind application-service boundaries as the MVP storage substrate.
The domain-core-owned contract requiring explicit unit metadata on physical values crossing boundaries.
Accepted shared dimension enum including length, mass, force, pressure, stress, etc.
An explicit recorded finding for missing/invalid data rather than a silent default.
Source attribution metadata required on governed records (source, license, certification, redistribution, review, privacy).
Private or user-owned design-basis check artifact; public project ships schemas and invented examples only.
User-supplied stress-intensification/flexibility input, not a public default.
The first solver slice defining six-DOF node ordering, two-node frame element stiffness, transformation, assembly, and dense solve.
Per-node DOF set Ux, Uy, Uz, Rx, Ry, Rz.
Iterative method for nonlinear supports recording active/inactive states, gaps, lift-off, friction, convergence.
Recovery of code-neutral mechanics stress components (axial, bending, torsional shear, pressure membrane) from element force resultants.
Explicit mechanics load input: weight, pressure, temperature, imposed displacement, hydrotest, wind, seismic, occasional.
Combination of primitive-load or result-state operands using user-defined factors, subtraction, and range envelopes.
Separation of mechanics-solve, user-rule-check, and human-acceptance authority domains.
Constraint that software output is decision support and must not declare code compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or professional reliance.
Bounded model-hash surface recording canonical JSON hashes, asset hashes, version stamps, and missing-evidence findings.
Schema-first request/result envelope for non-GUI solve execution, benchmark/regression automation, and result-export handoff.
Contract defining extension metadata, entrypoints, permissions, provenance, checksums, sandbox requirements, and no-bypass controls.
Calculates circular pipe section properties and mass-per-length from user-entered dimensions and density only.
Bounded evaluator over explicit expression trees supporting literals, variables, negation, arithmetic, and same-dimension comparisons.
GUI warning categories: SOLVE_BLOCKING, RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, PROVENANCE_WARNING, ASSUMPTION_WARNING, NONLINEAR_WARNING, IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING.
The bounded executor expected to be able to execute each deliverable.
